title: QUIC RFC 9000 Preferred Address Connection ID Constraint Verification
verification_method: Focused requirement-home execution for preferred_address connection-ID validation, runtime peer connection-ID state inspection, Release build, generated coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers preferred_address connection-ID constraints and active_connection_id_limit accounting for the selected RFC 9000 S18P2 requirements.
expected_result: The codec rejects invalid preferred_address connection-ID combinations, runtime commit maps invalid preferred_address connection-ID constraints to TRANSPORT_PARAMETER_ERROR, the peer connection-ID state records preferred_address as sequence 1, and active_connection_id_limit enforcement counts handshake, preferred_address, and later NEW_CONNECTION_ID values together.
procedure: Run the focused S18P2 preferred-address requirement-home filter.
preconditions: Existing preferred-address migration path selection remains unchanged.
Existing broad transport-parameter format/parse behavior remains available as supporting evidence but is not the focused proof source for this slice.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim closure for S8P1P3 address-validation token lifecycle work or for the rest of the S18P2 transport-parameter proof backlog.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-03. The Release build passed with zero warnings, the focused S18P2 preferred-address filter passed 15/15, the focused-plus-fuzz regression filter passed 16/16, selected requirements reached trace_clean in regenerated triage, SpecTrace core validation passed 337 artifacts, and the full no-build solution test suite passed 3702/3702.
